name: Gabriel India Ltd.
about: Gabriel India Limited manufactures and sells of ride control products to the automotive industry in India, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers canister shock absorbers, telescopic front forks, inverted front forks, mono shox, floating piston shock absorbers, semi-active front forks, and semi-active shock absorbers; rear shock absorbers, strut assemblies, FSD suspension, semi-active suspension systems, and gas springs; axle dampers, cabin dampers, and seat dampers. It also provides double-acting hydraulic shock absorbers for conventional coaches, shock absorbers for EMU/MEMU coaches, dampers for diesel and electric locomotives, dampers for rajdhani and shatabdi coaches, and dampers for vande bharat coaches. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~35% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~24% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 11.3% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 85 vs sector median 37; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 40, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
